cards.title: Past Echoes
cards.body: When the same old story resurfaces in an argument, it's easy to feel frustrated and wonder why it keeps coming back. But often, it’s not about holding a 'grudge' at all; it's a sign that something still feels unresolved for your partner. Maybe they didn't feel fully heard the first time, or a core fear keeps popping up in new ways. Instead of debating the past event, try leaning in to understand the unmet need or lingering emotion underneath it. What's one feeling you could actively listen for, beyond the old details?
cards.caption:
When old hurts resurface, it's a sign there's something new to understand. What helps you finally close the loop on those recurring feelings?

video_reels.line: The soft touch on the small of their back when you pass in the kitchen, a quiet 'I see you' in the middle of a busy day.
